title: BECE English Studies: Vocabulary & Register - NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies - Phrasal Verbs
subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Because the fresh fruits were rapidly approaching their expiry date, the supermarket manager decided to ________ the prices to clear the stock.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'mark down' means to reduce the price of an item for sale in order to encourage buyers.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Before the final examination commenced, the invigilator instructed the prefect to strictly ________ the standardized test booklets to all seated candidates.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'hand out' means to distribute something (such as exam papers) to a group of people.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Following the massive public outrage over the verified embezzlement scandal, the embattled minister was forced to ________ from his position.
questions.explain: The phrasal verb 'step down' specifically means to resign or voluntarily withdraw from an important job, public office, or official position.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

The dedicated international mediators sternly urged the conflicting political factions to honestly dialogue and try to ________ their deep-seated differences before the deadline.
questions.explain: To 'iron out' differences or problems is a phrasal verb meaning to quietly resolve or successfully settle a dispute through dialogue or careful negotiation.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the most appropriate option to complete the sentence:

Because her husband tragically perished very early, she commendably had to practically ________ their five children totally by herself.
questions.explain: In domestic family life phrasing, 'bring up' is a fundamental phrasal verb that strictly signifies looking after a child entirely until they are formally an adult.
questions.subject: NECO BECE (Nigeria) English Studies
